description.value: Blue Dog Kayaking is a Paddle Canada-certified sea kayaking and paddleboarding collective operating out of Mill Bay Marina, offering instruction from beginner to advanced levels including guide and instructor certification courses. Founded in 2015, it has grown into a collaborative model where independent instructors run their own programs under a shared framework, with a particular commitment to inclusive and women-specific programming. Touring cyclists passing through Mill Bay can access the marina waterfront for a paddle break or take a guided trip into the surrounding coastal waters.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming Blue Dog Kayaking is an active sea kayaking instruction and rental collective based at Mill Bay Marina (740 Handy Road, Mill Bay, BC), not Sidney as the OSM community field suggests. The contact page provides address, phone, and email directly. No amenity-specific evidence (bike parking, washrooms, showers, etc.) appears anywhere on the site; all amenity fields default to null. The phone number carries a 705 area code (Ontario), which is unusual for a BC business and warrants flagging.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the website address and manual_id both indicate Mill Bay — these are distinct communities on Vancouver Island; the community tag should be corrected to Mill Bay.
Phone number (705) 888 1051 uses a 705 area code (Ontario, Canada), which is unexpected for a BC-based business. May be a personal cell number retained from a previous location; worth verifying.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a live booking site, named instructors, and a confirmed physical address at Mill Bay Marina. Useful to touring cyclists as a waterfront attraction stop.

wow_evidence: Certified kayak/SUP school collective at Mill Bay Marina; lesson-based paddling stop.
blurb: Sea kayaking and paddleboard school at Mill Bay Marina.
